UTM Randomizer playground

Every control copies a link the way real sites do. Paste into the box at the bottom (or anywhere) to see what reached your clipboard. In Decoy mode tracking values turn into believable fakes, in Silly mode into nonsense, in Hybrid mode into a mix of both, and in Remove mode they disappear. Links under “Should not change” must paste exactly as shown.

Copy buttons

The different APIs sites use for “Copy link”.

Address bar

Open this page with tracking parameters. Once it has loaded, the address bar shows decoys (or nothing, in Remove mode), so copying the address, sharing the tab, or bookmarking it is already clean.

Outside the page

With “Watch the whole clipboard” on, links copied anywhere are cleaned within about a second: copy this one from a text editor, a chat app, or the address bar of a browser page like chrome://history, then paste it below.

https://example.com/story?id=11&utm_source=twitter&utm_medium=social&gclid=Cj0KCQjw9-KzBhDVARIsAF_BwE
